title: Research Assistant
org: Aarhus University, Dept. of Business Development and Technology (BTECH)
points: Built AskEIVA with the company EIVA: an internal AI assistant that helps customer service find answers in large technical manuals and past support tickets.
Designed and built TraceableAI, an open-source tool for AI literature reviews where every citation can be checked. The paper is accepted at OSSYM 2026 at CODE University, Berlin.

points.text: Supervise AI-focused MSc in Engineering projects, currently three:
sub: Process diagrams generated from unstructured data, to support project management across separate systems and departments.
A multivocal literature review of current context-engineering methods and their impact on researchers and practitioners.
AI adoption and governance, with recommendations for the safe use of AI in a security firm.

points: As main developer, build Coursebot, an AI course assistant that answers students' questions from the course material, for bachelor's and master's programmes.
Built Open Door, an open-source browser game that teaches threat modelling to student teams, based on the CyPro method from Aarhus University.
Taught master's students to build structured AI business cases with the 33A AI Cards® method, in a workshop I designed and ran. They learned to find high-value automation opportunities.
Headhunted for this fixed-term position by Associate Professor Eva Sørum Poulsen and Professor Mirko Presser.

title: Student Worker, Digitalization
org: The LEGO Group, Mould Engineering Enabling & Technology
points: As main developer, built MIND, an AI assistant used by 331 engineers at the LEGO Group to search their technical documentation. The proof of concept was estimated to save 240 hours.
Built 15+ business apps in Power Apps and 50+ automated workflows in Power Automate as a citizen developer.
Managed how apps were built, tested and released on the Power Platform, in the 10th largest environment at the LEGO Group.
Planned and carried out the move of 50 automated workflows and 30 apps as part of a digital transition.
Managed the split of a large form-processing process from one department into two.
Served as Technical Product Owner for 50+ SharePoint sites in Mould Engineering for 10 months.
Documented rework quality for moulds under ISO 9001 for 10 months.
Built and scaled automated engineering newsletters, tailored to the topics each reader chose.
Contributed to a machine-learning initiative that used image recognition to support mould designers.
Facilitated the TDC specialist community of 30–40 people.

title: Student Instructor, Web Technologies
points: Rated 4.9 / 5 by students on average for teaching the material.

title: Engineering Intern
org: The LEGO Group, Mould Engineering Prototypes
points: Interviewed 7 local planners and mapped how local planning was done across many Excel sheets, each with its own way of working.

Presented a one-page brief to management. The LEGO Group later approved Kinaxis Maestro as a unified planning tool, a need my analysis helped document.
